name: Boggard Warden

items.name: Blowgun
items.description: This long, narrow tube is used for shooting blowgun darts, using only the power of a forcefully exhaled breath.

items.name: Trident
items.description: This three-pronged, spear-like weapon typically has a 4-foot shaft. Like a spear, it can be wielded with one hand or thrown.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: A mix of furs, sturdy hide, and sometimes molded boiled leather, this armor provides protection due to its layers of leather, though its bulkiness slows the wearer down and decreases mobility.

items.name: Blowgun Darts
items.description: These thin, light darts are typically made of hardwood and stabilized with fletching of down or fur. They are often hollow so they can be used to deliver poison.

items.name: Hunting Spider Venom (On Darts)
items.description:
This venom erodes its target's defenses, aiding the spider in securing prey.

Activate Interact (Injury)

Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d10 poison damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 2 1d12 poison damage, Clumsy 1, and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 2d6 poison damage, Clumsy 2, and off-guard (1 round)

offensiveAbilities.name: Nature's Edge
offensiveAbilities.description: Boggard wardens are trained to take advantage of their foes' weak points when they're on unfavorable terrain. Enemies are Off-Guard to the boggard warden if they're in natural difficult terrain.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: A boggard warden deals 2d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swamp Stride
offensiveAbilities.description: A boggard cultist ignores difficult terrain caused by swamp terrain features.

offensiveAbilities.name: Terrifying Croak
offensiveAbilities.description:
The boggard warden unleashes a terrifying croak. Any non-boggard within 30 feet becomes Frightened 1 unless they succeed at a DC 28 Will save.

Those who critically succeed are temporarily immune for 1 minute.

offensiveAbilities.name: Tongue Grab
offensiveAbilities.description: If the boggard warden hits a creature with its tongue, that creature becomes Grabbed by the boggard. Unlike with a normal Grab, the creature isn't Immobilized, but it can't move beyond the reach of the boggard's tongue. A creature can sever the tongue by hitting AC 24 and dealing at least 10 slashing damage. Though this doesn't deal any damage to the boggard, it prevents it from using its tongue Strike until it regrows its tongue, which takes a week.

description: Boggards are aggressive humanoid amphibians that thrive in swamps, marshes, and even some rain forests. Boggards hatch from eggs into tadpoles, fiercely competing for food and even consuming their siblings in that struggle. Over 3 years, the surviving boggards develops arms, legs, and lungs while learning the rudiments of hunting, crafts, and warfare-everything needed to survive in their might-makes-right society. At the top of most boggard hierarchies lords a hulking swampseer imbued with sinister divine magic.
